answer: A fresh identity must climb a public service ladder: ten audited micro-jobs, each harder than the last, before it can take paid work. Like a relic, finished rungs stay on-ledger as proof; like an opal, a completed ladder is rare and valuable. A fake costs about $3 of compute plus 2 POA in fees, and each extra identity from the same operator adds two rungs, so the tenth fake costs about five times the first — a whisper of profit becomes a loss.
